outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic of breast anatomy plus a classification table; it contains no plotted averaged data requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating study aims, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the experimental method (luciferase recordings), not a data plot.
Panel D shows idealized illustrative curves and a mock heatmap within a schematic explaining the analysis workflow, not actual averaged data with error bars.
Panel E depicts a schematic/illustrative correlation heatmap used to explain the method, not real quantified data requiring individual points.
Panel F contains an idealized illustrative growth curve inside a schematic explaining the imaging/quantification approach, not measured averaged data.
Panel G shows an idealized dose-response curve illustration within a schematic of the drug-sensitivity workflow, not actual experimental averages.
Panel H is a schematic with illustrative gene expression/mutation grids representing the analysis concept, not real averaged data.

Panel I shows illustrative example scatter plots (PCA and 3D cluster diagrams) used to explain the concept of subtype definition, not averaged/summary statistics of real data requiring individual point overlay; the individual points shown are themselves the illustrative markers, not means needing raw data overlay.
